title: Table selection labels
statement: For a type $S$ and a natural number $k$, a table selection label is either a state-and-output pair consisting of an optional state from $S$ and an output-register value, or a symbol label consisting of an optional index in $\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$ and two Boolean values.
